museumsArt|amalfi.overview: The Amalfi Coast is not a major art destination, but it offers a few specialized museums and local galleries that provide a break from the sun. Visitors can explore the Museo della Carta (Paper Museum) and the Diocesan Museum in Amalfi, or the small Coral Museum in Ravello. Positano also hosts several independent contemporary art galleries. The best time is from April to October when all venues maintain regular hours.
